title: MotorShow
description: `hpr motors show`: each motor's figures, worked out from its thrust curve.

kind.description: What kind of result this is: copied from a curve file, or computed from it.

motors.description: The motors found: every catalog match for a name, or every motor in a file.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

trust.description:
The trust note the text form ends with: where the figures come from, what they were
checked against, and what to go by instead (decision record ADR-213).

warnings.description: What the reader accepted with a caveat, in file order.

CatalogFile.description: One of a catalog motor's curve files, with its check against the motor's stated figures.

check.description: The file's check: its figures against the stated ones, each held to 1%.

flown.description: Whether this is the file the motor flies: the first bundled file in this order.

license.description: The data license its uploader chose, as ThrustCurve.org records it.

CheckedPair.description: One figure of a curve file's check, in the unit its key names.

file.description: The file's figure, worked out from its curve as the simulator flies it.

oneOf.description: The ejection charge fires this many seconds after burnout.
No ejection charge: the forward closure is plugged.
A `0`: the RASP format means a charge at burnout, but most files mean plugged.

FileCheck.description:
A curve file's check (decision records ADR-005 and ADR-298): its total impulse over the whole
curve, its NFPA 1125 burn time and its average thrust (that impulse over that burn time),
each against the figure ThrustCurve.org's record of the motor states. A figure passes when
`|file - stated|` is at most 1% of `stated`.

oneOf.description: RASP `.eng`.
RockSim `.rse`.

FileLicense.description: A curve file's data license, as ThrustCurve.org records it.

oneOf.description: Public domain.
"Free usage": by ThrustCurve.org's definition, terms such as GPL or Creative Commons.
Other, restricted terms.
No license recorded.

Kind.description: What kind of result a command printed: the kind every figure in it is.

oneOf.description: From a model of the flight, not measured.
Measured: an altimeter's log, or a weather balloon's sounding.
A weather model's forecast.
A reanalysis: a weather model's fit to past observations, such as ERA5.
Copied from a data file, such as a motor's curve file, or computed from it.
A measurement set against a model: a log against a simulation of it.

MeasuredBy.description: Who measured a curve, as ThrustCurve.org records it.

oneOf.description: A certification body's test.
The manufacturer.
A ThrustCurve.org user.

MotorFigures.description: One motor's figures, worked out by HPR Sim from its thrust curve.

average_thrust_n.description: Average thrust, N: total impulse over the burn time.

burn_end_s.description: When the NFPA 1125 burn ends, s.

burn_start_s.description: When the NFPA 1125 burn starts, s.

burn_time_s.description:
Burn time, s, by NFPA 1125: from when thrust first reaches 5% of its peak to when it last
falls to it.

impulse_class.description: The impulse class the total impulse falls in, such as `J`.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer, as the catalog or the file writes it.

name.description: The motor's name: the catalog's designation, or the file's.

peak_thrust_n.description: Peak thrust, N: the curve's largest point.

source.description: Where the motor and its curve come from.

total_impulse_ns.description: Total impulse, N·s: the thrust curve's area, joining its points with straight lines.

oneOf.description: The bundled catalog, with a curve file from ThrustCurve.org.

files.description:
Every curve file the catalog lists for the motor, in the order its default is taken
(decision record ADR-298): a file whose check passes first, then RASP before RockSim,
each by who measured it.

oneOf.description: A motor file named on the command line.

Warning.description: Something a reader accepted with a caveat.

line.description: The 1-based line in the file, when it is about one.

message.description: What was found, and how it was read.

motor.description: The motor it is about, when it is about one.

oneOf.description: A whole motor had an error and was left out.
A value was left out.
Something unusual was read as it stands.
